request.style: English, male warm baritone solo with soft acoustic guitar, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, gentle cello, light piano, atmospheric pads, hopeful and tender mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Everyone in Asia turned away
Phygelus and Hermogenes did flee
But he searched hard until he found me
In the prison where I was to be

[Chorus]
May the Lord show mercy to his house
For he often refreshed me somehow
He was not ashamed of my chains
Faithful in the wind and in the rains

[Verse]
You know well his service in Ephesus
A devotion that no one can refuse
He came to Rome to seek me out
And brought comfort and quiet about

[Chorus]
May the Lord show mercy to his house
For he often refreshed me somehow
He was not ashamed of my chains
Faithful in the wind and in the rains

[Bridge]
May the Lord grant him mercy on that Day
For the faithfulness he chose to pay
Greet Prisca and Aquila too
And the household standing firm and true

[Chorus]
May the Lord show mercy to his house
For he often refreshed me somehow
He was not ashamed of my chains
Faithful in the wind and in the rains
